Your task is summarize the modifications made in the patch.
Your summary should consist of two parts, modifications in each file and their relationships.

From 96dd922c198286681fbbc15100e196e0f629e2fb Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Brian Norris <computersforpeace@gmail.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2015 15:36:16 -0800
Subject: [PATCH] mtd: jz4740_nand: fix build on jz4740 after removing gpio.h

Fallout from commit 832f5dacfa0b ("MIPS: Remove all the uses of custom gpio.h")

We see errors like this:

drivers/mtd/nand/jz4740_nand.c: In function 'jz_nand_detect_bank':
drivers/mtd/nand/jz4740_nand.c:340:9: error: 'JZ_GPIO_MEM_CS0' undeclared (first use in this function)
drivers/mtd/nand/jz4740_nand.c:340:9: note: each undeclared identifier is reported only once for each function it appears in
drivers/mtd/nand/jz4740_nand.c:359:2: error: implicit declaration of function 'jz_gpio_set_function' [-Werror=implicit-function-declaration]
drivers/mtd/nand/jz4740_nand.c:359:29: error: 'JZ_GPIO_FUNC_MEM_CS0' undeclared (first use in this function)
drivers/mtd/nand/jz4740_nand.c:399:29: error: 'JZ_GPIO_FUNC_NONE' undeclared (first use in this function)
drivers/mtd/nand/jz4740_nand.c: In function 'jz_nand_probe':
drivers/mtd/nand/jz4740_nand.c:528:13: error: 'JZ_GPIO_MEM_CS0' undeclared (first use in this function)
drivers/mtd/nand/jz4740_nand.c: In function 'jz_nand_remove':
drivers/mtd/nand/jz4740_nand.c:555:14: error: 'JZ_GPIO_MEM_CS0' undeclared (first use in this function)

Patched similarly to:

https://patchwork.linux-mips.org/patch/11089/

Fixes: 832f5dacfa0b ("MIPS: Remove all the uses of custom gpio.h")
Signed-off-by: Brian Norris <computersforpeace@gmail.com>

diff --git a/drivers/mtd/nand/jz4740_nand.c b/drivers/mtd/nand/jz4740_nand.c
index dc4e8446f1ff..5a99a93ed025 100644
--- a/drivers/mtd/nand/jz4740_nand.c
+++ b/drivers/mtd/nand/jz4740_nand.c
@@ -25,6 +25,7 @@
 
 #include <linux/gpio.h>
 
+#include <asm/mach-jz4740/gpio.h>
 #include <asm/mach-jz4740/jz4740_nand.h>
 
 #define JZ_REG_NAND_CTRL	0x50
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/mtd/nand/jz4740_nand.c`**
   - Added the line `#include <asm/mach-jz4740/gpio.h>` to include the necessary GPIO definitions that were removed in a previous commit. This inclusion addresses the undeclared identifiers and implicit function declaration errors that arose after the removal of `gpio.h`.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modification in `jz4740_nand.c` is a direct response to the fallout from the earlier commit (832f5dacfa0b) that removed the custom `gpio.h`. The errors reported in the patch indicate that several GPIO-related identifiers and functions were no longer recognized in the code, leading to build failures. By including the new header file `gpio.h` from the `asm/mach-jz4740` directory, the patch restores access to the necessary GPIO definitions, thereby fixing the build issues caused by the previous changes.

Here is the commit message:
mtd: jz4740_nand: fix build on jz4740 after removing gpio.h

Fallout from commit 832f5dacfa0b ("MIPS: Remove all the uses of custom gpio.h")

We see errors like this:

drivers/mtd/nand/jz4740_nand.c: In function 'jz_nand_detect_bank':
drivers/mtd/nand/jz4740_nand.c:340:9: error: 'JZ_GPIO_MEM_CS0' undeclared (first use in this function)
drivers/mtd/nand/jz4740_nand.c:340:9: note: each undeclared identifier is reported only once for each function it appears in
drivers/mtd/nand/jz4740_nand.c:359:2: error: implicit declaration of function 'jz_gpio_set_function' [-Werror=implicit-function-declaration]
drivers/mtd/nand/jz4740_nand.c:359:29: error: 'JZ_GPIO_FUNC_MEM_CS0' undeclared (first use in this function)
drivers/mtd/nand/jz4740_nand.c:399:29: error: 'JZ_GPIO_FUNC_NONE' undeclared (first use in this function)
drivers/mtd/nand/jz4740_nand.c: In function 'jz_nand_probe':
drivers/mtd/nand/jz4740_nand.c:528:13: error: 'JZ_GPIO_MEM_CS0' undeclared (first use in this function)
drivers/mtd/nand/jz4740_nand.c: In function 'jz_nand_remove':
drivers/mtd/nand/jz4740_nand.c:555:14: error: 'JZ_GPIO_MEM_CS0' undeclared (first use in this function)

Patched similarly to:

https://patchwork.linux-mips.org/patch/11089/

Fixes: 832f5dacfa0b ("MIPS: Remove all the uses of custom gpio.h")
Signed-off-by: Brian Norris <computersforpeace@gmail.com>

Here is the root cause:
The bug was caused by the removal of the custom `gpio.h` header file in a previous commit, which led to several GPIO-related identifiers and functions being undeclared in the `jz4740_nand.c` file. This resulted in compilation errors when the code attempted to reference these missing definitions.

Here is the patch:
 #include <linux/gpio.h>
 
+#include <asm/mach-jz4740/gpio.h>
 #include <asm/mach-jz4740/jz4740_nand.h>

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c
JZ_GPIO_MEM_CS0
jz_gpio_set_function
JZ_GPIO_FUNC_MEM_CS0
```
Reason:
The removal of the custom `gpio.h` header file caused the identifiers `JZ_GPIO_MEM_CS0` and `JZ_GPIO_FUNC_MEM_CS0`, as well as the function `jz_gpio_set_function`, to become undeclared in the `jz4740_nand.c` file, leading to compilation errors.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
#include <linux/gpio.h>
#include <asm/mach-jz4740/gpio.h>
```
Reason:
By including the appropriate `gpio.h` header file from the `asm/mach-jz4740` directory, the missing GPIO-related identifiers and functions are reintroduced, resolving the compilation errors.
